text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that enables computers to see and understand the world through images and videos. One of its basic tasks is image recognition, which identifies what is in a picture, such as a cat or a tree. A more complex task is object detection, where a system not only names objects but also finds their exact locations in an image, often drawing boxes around them. These technologies have many real-world applications. For example, in self-driving cars, object detection helps the vehicle recognize pedestrians, traffic signs, and other cars, allowing it to navigate safely. From medical scans to smartphone photo sorting, computer vision is quickly becoming a part of everyday life.
